finding.claim: CSS url() filter bypass: an escaped ident (url\28) evades Loofah scrub_css url/bad_url child check, letting a cursor:url("remote") declaration through sanitize_css / style attribute scrubbing, causing attacker-chosen remote resource loads. Not script execution. Confirmed by reading source; Loofah 2.15.0 is the only copy available and may differ from the version this gem requires.
finding.source: Attacker-controlled style attribute value passed to sanitize_css (lib/rails/html/sanitizer.rb:173-175) or to scrub_css_attribute when the app allows the style attribute (lib/rails/html/scrubbers.rb:128-133).
finding.sink: Sanitized style attribute output (Loofah scrub_css, loofah-2.15.0 lib/loofah/html5/scrub.rb:79-128).

trace.note: consume_escaped decodes hex escapes inside idents
leading backslash routed to consume_ident, so url\28 becomes ident 'url('
url/bad_url child check only matches :url/:bad_url nodes, so escaped ident passes
ident kept because cursor is not a shorthand property
values re-joined and re-parsed into cursor:url( "..." )

finding.guards_checked: url/bad_url child filter (bypassed); property allowlist (enforced, cursor allowed); shorthand keyword check (not applicable to cursor); quoted-string check (enforced, irrelevant); first-declaration-only re-parse (does not block url())

finding.claim: Plausible concurrency issue: a single sanitizer instance keeps one shared @permit_scrubber whose tags/attributes are reset per call, so concurrent calls on a shared instance with different per-call tags/attributes can scrub with another call's allowlist. Conditional on app-level instance sharing; not confirmed against the Rails helper.
finding.source: Per-call options[:tags] / options[:attributes] on a shared sanitizer instance used from multiple threads.
finding.sink: Shared @permit_scrubber allowlist used in fragment.scrub! (lib/rails/html/sanitizer.rb:164-167, lib/rails/html/scrubbers.rb:58-63).

trace.note: scrub runs with whatever allowlist is currently set

finding.guards_checked: validate! duplicates input arrays (scrubbers.rb:59,63), so caller arrays are not mutated; no locking; Rails sanitize helper instantiation not verified
